steps.en: Register the repo as a plugin marketplace in Claude Code
steps.zh: 在 Claude Code 里把仓库注册为插件市场

steps.en: Install one domain plugin, not the whole catalog
steps.zh: 安装一个领域插件，而不是整个目录

steps.en: Loads only that plugin's agents, skills and commands into context
steps.zh: 只把该插件的 agent、skill 和 command 加载进上下文

steps.en: Hand it the out-of-zone task; the agent delegates to the domain specialist
steps.zh: 把舒适区之外的任务交出去，agent 委派给领域专家

steps.en: The specialist runs with its bundled skills on its tiered model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku)
steps.zh: 专家带着自带 skill、按其档位模型（Opus/Sonnet/Haiku）执行

value.en: Ready-made domain specialists that follow you across seven harnesses from one Markdown source
value.zh: 一个 Markdown 源产出的现成领域专家，跟着你跨七种 harness

sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wshobson/agents/main/README.md — Quick start / Claude Code (`/plugin marketplace add wshobson/agents`, `/plugin install python-development  # or any of 94 plugins`), verified against README at commit 9b15b34 on 2026-09-28
README 'How it works' (installing a plugin loads only its components into context) and 'Tiered model strategy' table (Opus / inherit / Sonnet / Haiku), same commit
